verdict.rationale: Baseten lets you deploy open-source or custom models from any framework, including `transformers`, on dedicated GPUs, which covers self-deploying embedding models. A community developer reports running embedding workloads on Baseten and pairing them with a high-concurrency client, and the docs offer a Performance Client for concurrent requests. However, the evidence never shows a first-party embeddings or rerank endpoint; the Model APIs are documented only for LLM chat. Missing for 10: documented embeddings API, any reranking support, and first-party docs for retrieval-pipeline use.
